_note: Tier 2 only: PE has no variable for the 7 USC 2014(d)(7) student-child earned income exclusion. Exposes the monthly person-level amount. The household-level (d)(2) irregular-income rule is not a root-entity output when the root is Person, so it is not exposed.

_input_notes.person_is_elementary_or_secondary_school: PE has no K-12 flag; full-time student is the closest PE concept and is a presumption for adults.
_input_notes.child_earned_income_amount: yearly PE employment income divided by 12 for the monthly rule.
